definition.content:
## Prefect Overview 

This dashboard provides a high-level overview of your Prefect Server. It is organized into sections covering flow performance and task-level drilldowns, health metrics for work queues, work pools, and deployments, as well as related databases commonly used with Prefect. All metrics are collected through the Prefect API.

### Further Reading

-   [Prefect Server API Documentation](https://docs.prefect.io/v3/api-ref/rest-api/server)
-   [Prefect Home Page](https://www.prefect.io/)
High-level snapshot of overall system activity, summarizing backlog size, flow age, throughput, success rate, and monitor statuses to reflect current system health and stability.
Breakdown of task-level execution metrics, including throughput, duration, and failure rates, to provide insight into performance distribution and task-level issues within flows.

definition.title: Task Execution Duration Avg per Task Key
Task Run Summary per Task Key

definition.content: High-level view of flow execution performance, including success rates, latency, and queue wait times, along with failure and crash counts to surface reliability issues and execution bottlenecks.

definition.title: Flow Run Success Rate Over Time (%)
Flow Run Failure and Crashed Count

definition.content: View of work queue state and scheduling efficiency, including backlog size, queue age, polling frequency, and concurrency usage to indicate how effectively work is being processed.
Overview of deployment readiness and execution performance, including status indicators and latency comparisons to highlight differences across deployments.

definition.title: Deployments per Work Queue and Work Pool

definition.content: Snapshot of worker infrastructure health, including availability, heartbeat age, and pool status to reflect worker responsiveness and system capacity.
Overview of supporting database performance, including latency, connection counts, and memory usage, to highlight potential infrastructure constraints affecting system behavior.

definition.title: PostgreSQL Buffer Cache (Hits vs Disk Reads)

definition.content: High-level overview of log activity, highlighting error frequency, log volume by status, and recent failures to reflect the system’s current health and stability.
